ios.desc:
Land your dream job faster with Resume AI.
This is your all-in-one career tool powered by AI to create perfectly optimized resumes, cover letters, and interview prep—tailored for every job you apply to.

How it works:
Upload your resume or fill in your details—Resume AI will do the rest. You’ll get a polished, professional resume that’s ready to pass automated job filters and impress recruiters. Want a tailored resume or cover letter for each job? Just paste the job description and let the AI handle it. Getting ready for an interview? Practice instantly and get feedback to improve your answers

What Resume AI does:
• Transforms your resume to beat ATS (Applicant Tracking System) used by companies to filter candidates
• Automatically rewrites and enhances resume content for clarity and impact*
• Generates tailored resumes and cover letters based on any job post*
• Prepares you for interviews with realistic questions + smart AI feedback*
• Fully powered by AI—zero fluff, 100% results-driven

Why it’s different:
Most apps just give you tips. Resume AI does the actual work—rewriting, optimizing, customizing—so you get real results, not just advice.

Built for job seekers in tech, marketing, sales, healthcare, and more.

Start standing out. Let Resume AI do the heavy lifting for you

*RESUME GENERATION RESULTS & AI FEATURES REQUIRE A SUBSCRIPTION
